📺 Black Bird (2022)

Black Bird follows Jimmy Keene, a former high school football star whose promising future takes a devastating turn when he is sentenced to prison for drug-related crimes. Facing a lengthy sentence, Jimmy receives an extraordinary offer from federal authorities: transfer to a maximum-security prison, befriend suspected serial killer Larry Hall, and convince him to confess to his crimes and reveal where his victims are buried. In exchange, Jimmy could earn his freedom. As he enters a dangerous environment filled with violent criminals, he must gain Larry’s trust without exposing his true intentions. With time running out, Jimmy finds himself trapped in a terrifying psychological battle where one wrong move could cost him everything. Starring Taron Egerton, Paul Walter Hauser, and Ray Liotta, the series delivers gripping suspense, powerful performances, and an unforgettable true-crime story about manipulation, justice, survival, and the search for truth.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Thriller • Biography

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 48–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Dennis Lehane

📺 Seasons: 1 • 6 Episodes

📚 Based On: The true story told in In with the Devil by James Keene and Hillel Levin.

🏆 Awards: Paul Walter Hauser won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Limited Series.

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV+ in the United States.
